comments.body: Shouldn't the notification be deleted by itself when the insulin started being given again ? It was probably a temporary message during a profile change by automation as at that time, I was surely sleeping.
this message is not confirmed automatically

Ok. Looks like something changed in the DASH driver. This message was almost never stuck (or maybe shown ??) till very recently. I only got it when pump was far from phone. 

Now, it seems to happen once a day. When I see the notification and check the DASH tab, I need to reactivate insulin distribution (but not sure if I need to do it systematically...)

Will go on observing to give more precise details.

I'm not sure if this didn't start since @Philoul corrected an untranslated message to translatable (message was _uncertain_ ). Can't see why/if it changed anything... Wild guess only ;)
